status: ILLUSTRATIVE untested prioritisation candidates — NOT observed experiment results

proposals.name: Independent claim-to-primary-source review
proposals.question: Are claims and limitations actually supported by the cited passage?
proposals.target: Every central factual claim checked; zero critical fabricated citations
proposals.success_criterion: Two independent reviews with page/quote provenance and zero critical unsupported claims
proposals.method: Source audit of 20 unfamiliar responses with reviewer disagreement preserved

proposals.name: Blind first-use preference and no-reply test
proposals.question: Would diverse first-time users genuinely use this recommendation?
proposals.target: At least 7/10 volunteers choose yes or with minor changes, including justified no-reply
proposals.success_criterion: 10 independent consented tasks, feedback segmented by first-use and stance, no serious safety misses
proposals.method: One comment; one recommendation; volunteer blind ratings and observed task completion

proposals.name: Maximise provocative engagement
proposals.question: Can we increase comment volume?
proposals.method: Provocative prompts and covert targeted nudges

proposals.name: Blind citation and escalation trial
proposals.question: Can a reviewer verify each evidence span and abstention?
proposals.target: Zero critical unsafe handoffs, high citation precision
proposals.success_criterion: Two human reviewers check a newly assembled holdout and log all critical misses
proposals.method: Anonymised public documents; source-level annotation; baseline versus candidate
assumptions: Public legal materials are representative only of a limited domain

proposals.name: One real shared cooking event
proposals.question: Can people join, show up and make a real connection?
proposals.target: At least 8 attendees and meaningful post-event feedback
proposals.success_criterion: Document actual attendance and consented usefulness; identify blockers
proposals.method: Small voluntary Roll Together event with accessible RSVP and post-event interviews
assumptions: A small cohort is possible without a permanent venue

proposals.name: One order-to-fulfilment trial
proposals.question: Will customers order again and can we fulfil sustainably?
proposals.target: No allergen incidents; positive contribution margin
proposals.success_criterion: Record real attempts, fulfilment, customer review and costs
proposals.method: Small opt-in plant-based menu pilot; costs tracked per fulfilled meal
assumptions: Supplier pricing and permissions must be verified

provenance: Authored as hypotheses, not collected user data. Ordinal estimates are proposal-maker judgments and must be challenged by users.
